packageRules.description: Auto-merge low-risk updates once CI passes
Auto-merge devDependency minor bumps once CI passes

Auto-merge workflow action minor bumps once CI passes (#101). Each action is pinned by SHA with a # vX.Y.Z comment (#97), so a minor release arrives as a minor PR. Before #97 the floating @vN tags took it at run time with no PR, and the PR's own CI runs the new action before the merge.

Keep the engines.bun floor out of the top-level rangeStrategy bump, since #89 leaves the Bun version pins alone: under bump, a dry run opens a renovate/bun-1.x PR that raises ">=1.1.0" to the newest Bun, and the dry run on main before #89 did not. auto leaves a range the newest Bun already satisfies alone.

Open no PR for .nvmrc (#81). It names only the Node major: CI's setup-node and railpack on Coolify each pick a release of that major on their own (setup-node takes a cached one before it downloads), so CI and production share the major, not always the patch. Renovate's node versioning reads "26" as the single version 26.0.0, so a dry run proposes 26.13.0 now and would open a PR for every Node release, each writing a full version that then pins one release. A new Node major arrives as the @types/node major PR instead: in that PR, set .nvmrc and flake.nix nodejs_<major> to the same major. tests/node-pins.test.ts (#95) fails that PR's CI until they do.
